content.json:
# RedRays security results
Latest observations from scheduled exports. Source identities are scoped to a source record unless IdentityScope specifies otherwise. Review observation age before interpreting a finding as current.

This workbook shows security assessment findings. It does not include SAP Security Audit Log data or activate Microsoft's built-in SAP audit detections. If a table is empty, check export health and scan coverage: the module may be disabled, data may not have arrived, or the scan may have found no issues.

content.title: Latest findings by module and severity
content.query:
union RedRaysVulnerabilities_CL, RedRaysAbapFindings_CL, RedRaysCloudFindings_CL, RedRaysSoDFindings_CL, RedRaysProfileChecks_CL, RedRaysPasswordFindings_CL
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by FindingKey
| summarize Findings=count() by Module, SourceSeverity, SourceStatus

content.title: Export health (stale after 60 minutes)
content.query:
let maxHeartbeatAge = 60m;
RedRaysExportHealth_CL
| where RecordKind == 'HEARTBEAT'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ProductInstanceId
| extend HeartbeatAge = now() - TimeGenerated
| extend ExportHealth = iff(HeartbeatAge > maxHeartbeatAge, 'STALE', 'RECENT')
| project ProductInstanceId, LastObservation=TimeGenerated, HeartbeatAge, ExportHealth, SourceStatus, QueuedCount, PendingCount

content.title: Scan coverage
content.query:
RedRaysScanRuns_CL
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by FindingKey
| summarize Runs=count() by Module, SourceStatus, CoverageStatus

content.json: Export health is operational monitoring, not an ATT&CK detection. Adjust the 60-minute threshold above the export interval and ingestion delay. Only instances with a heartbeat in the selected time range appear; an empty result does not prove that exports are healthy. For notifications, configure a separate Azure Monitor log search alert with an explicit inventory of expected instances.
